biocs.name: Office Injects Code into Process
biocs.description: Microsoft Office launches a process that injects code into another process
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'winword.exe' or actor_process_image_name = 'excel.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'winword.exe' and action_process_image_name != 'excel.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'winword.exe' or causality_actor_process_image_name = 'excel.exe'
